lines.t: (Verse 1)
From the silence came a voice,
A whisper calling hearts to choice.
The Word of Life, in love He came,
To bear our cross, to take our shame.
(Verse 1)
In the wilderness, a cry was heard,
Prepare the way, fulfill the Word.
The Light has come, the blind now see,
The captive heart is set free.
He spoke the truth, the veil was torn,
The broken healed, the lost reborn.
The storm was calmed by His command,
Salvation flowed through nail-pierced hands.
You are the Light of salvation.
The Word eternal, grace and true,
All creation bows to You.
Heaven trembles, earth stands still,
Your voice fulfills the Father’s will.
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…),
Redeemer, King, forever You.
He called the weary to His rest,
Placed the humble on His breast.
Mercy flowed like rivers wide,
Grace unending, sanctified.
The trumpet sounds, the heavens cry,
The King of Glory drawing nigh.
The Bride awaits, her heart aflame,
She lives to honor His great Name.
(echo harmonies)
Holy… holy…
Faithful and true…
YahuShua… (echo: YahuShua…)
The garden wept, the stone was rolled,
The story of redemption told.
From death to life, the Lamb arose,
The ancient gates forever close.
His light shines on, His truth remains,
The righteous clothed, the sinner gains.
The Shepherd calls, His flock will hear,
“Draw near Me, for I am near.”
You are the Light of salvation.
The King of Glory, faithful Friend,
Beginning now, without an end.
Heaven rejoices, angels sing,
The Savior reigns, the risen King.
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…),
Forevermore, our everything.
The dawn will break, the night shall fade,
The path of truth, by Him was made.
And in His light, all hearts shall see,
The face of love — eternity.
